email.account_deletion.body:
Hello,

You asked us to delete your Household account. It is switched off now: nobody can sign in to it, and every browser and device has been signed out. In {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} it will be deleted for good, together with what you kept privately. What you added to a household you share stays with that household, without your name on it.

If you change your mind, open the link below before then. It cancels the deletion, and you can sign in again as before.

{link}

If you didn’t ask for this, open the link now, then sign in and change your password.
email.account_deletion.subject: Your Household account will be deleted in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
email.billing_moved.body:
Hello,

{member} took over billing for {household} on Household, as you offered. From now on the subscription is charged to them, not to you. What you have already paid for runs to the end of its period, and nothing was charged twice.

You are still an owner of {household}, and can see its billing here:

{link}
email.billing_moved.subject: {member} now pays for {household} on Household
email.billing_offer.body:
Hello,

{member} pays for {household} on Household and has offered to hand billing to you. Nothing changes unless you accept: until then {member} keeps paying, and the subscription carries on exactly as it is.

To accept and add your card, or to decline, open:

{link}

The offer lapses in 14 days.
email.billing_offer.subject: {member} offered you billing for {household} on Household
email.export_ready.body:
Hello,

The export you asked for{kind, select, household { of {household}} other {}} is ready. You can download it from Household for the next {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}:

{link}

After that it is removed, and you can ask for a new one at any time.
email.export_ready.subject: Your Household export is ready
email.graduate.body:
Hello,

{owner} is turning your child profile in {household}, {member}, into an account of your own with this email address. Everything you made stays with you.

To finish, open the link below and choose a password. It works for 14 days.

{link}

Until then, you sign in with your PIN as before. If you weren’t expecting this, you can ignore this email: nothing changes unless you choose a password.
email.graduate.subject: {owner} is setting up an account of your own on Household
email.household_deletion.body:
Hello,

An owner of {household} has scheduled the household for deletion on Household. In {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} everything in it will be deleted for good, for every member. Until then it works as it did, and any owner can cancel the deletion in the household’s settings.

If there is anything in it you want to keep, take a copy before then.
email.household_deletion.subject: {household} will be deleted in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
email.household_deletion_cancelled.body:
Hello,

The deletion of {household} on Household was cancelled. Nothing in it was removed, and it goes on as before.
email.household_suspended.body:
Hello,

{household} has been suspended on Household, and nobody can open it until the suspension is lifted. This is what we can tell you about why:

{notice}

If you think this is a mistake, contact Household support.

email.household_unsuspended.body:
Hello,

The suspension of {household} on Household has been lifted. Everything in it is as it was, and each device loads it again the next time it syncs.
email.household_unsuspended.subject: {household} is no longer suspended
email.identity_linked.body:
Hello,

{provider} was just linked to your Household account, and can now sign you in to it.

If you did this, there’s nothing more to do. If you didn’t, reset your password now, then unlink {provider} in your account:

{link}
email.identity_linked.subject: {provider} can now sign you in to Household
email.invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {household} on Household
email.invoice.body:
Hello,

The payment for {household} on Household went through. Invoice {number} is ready, with the subscription and any extra storage as separate lines.

You can read and download it here:

{link}

You are getting this because you pay for {household}.
email.invoice.subject: Your Household invoice for {household}
email.member_removed.body:
Hello,

An owner of {household} removed you from the household on Household. You no longer see anything in it, and the other households you belong to are as they were. What you made there stays with the household.

If you think this was a mistake, ask one of its owners to invite you again.
email.member_removed.subject: You were removed from {household} on Household
email.mfa_disabled.body:
Hello,

The second step for your Household account, the code from your authenticator app, was just turned off. Signing in now needs only your password.

If you did this, there’s nothing more to do. If you didn’t, reset your password now, then turn the second step on again:

{link}
email.mfa_disabled.subject: The second step was turned off for your Household account
email.password_changed.body:
Hello,

The password for your Household account was just changed.

If you did this, there’s nothing more to do. If you didn’t, reset your password now:

{link}
email.password_changed.subject: Your Household password was changed
email.password_reset.body:
Hello,

Someone asked to reset the password for your Household account. To choose a new one, open the link below. It works for one hour.

{link}

If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.
email.password_reset.subject: Reset your Household password
email.payment_failed.subject: We couldn’t collect the payment for {household}
email.payment_not_collected.body:
Hello,

The bank payment that was to start the subscription for {household} on Household did not go through, so the subscription was not started and nothing was charged. {household} is as it was before.

To try again, from the same account or with another payment method, subscribe here:

{link}

You are getting this because you set up the payment for {household}.
email.payment_not_collected.subject: The payment for {household} did not go through
email.recovery_code_used.subject: A recovery code was used for your Household account
email.register_existing.body:
Hello,

Someone, perhaps you, tried to create a Household account with this email address. It already has one, so nothing was changed.

To get in, sign in. If you’ve forgotten your password, you can reset it from the same page:

{link}

If this wasn’t you, you can ignore this email.
email.register_existing.subject: You already have a Household account
email.retention_warning.body:
Hello,

{household} is {state, select, canceled {cancelled} other {read-only}} on Household, and its data will be deleted in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Until then, everything in it can still be read and exported.

To keep it, an owner can resume the subscription from the household’s settings, and nothing will be deleted. To keep a copy instead, export the household from the same place.

You are getting this because you are an owner of {household}.
email.retention_warning.subject: {household}’s data will be deleted in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
email.token_reuse.body:
Hello,

We signed {named, select, yes {“{device}”} other {one of your devices}} out of your Household account, because its sign-in was used twice, which happens when someone has taken a copy of it.

If it’s your device, sign in on it again and there’s nothing more to do. If you don’t recognise it, reset your password now. That signs every device out, whoever holds it:

{link}
email.token_reuse.subject: We signed a device out of your Household account
email.verify_email.body:
Hello,

Please confirm that this is your email address by opening the link below. It works for 24 hours.

{link}

If you didn’t create a Household account, you can ignore this email.
email.verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address for Household
household.child.create.again.differs: The two PINs are not the same. Type it again.
household.child.create.again.label: The same PIN again
household.child.create.lock.help: This is chosen here, as the profile is made. It can’t be changed afterwards.
household.child.create.lock.label: Lock their Home: they see the Home an owner set, and can’t rearrange it
household.child.create.made: {name}’s profile is made. They sign in with the household’s code, their profile and their PIN.
household.child.create.name.help: What the household calls them, and what they pick when they sign in.
household.child.create.name.label: Name
household.child.create.name.missing: Add a name, at most 80 characters.
household.child.create.pin.help: 4 to 6 digits. They sign in on their own phone with the household’s code, their profile and this PIN, and no email address is collected. It isn’t shown again once the profile is made: an owner can set a new one.
household.child.create.pin.invalid: A PIN is 4 to 6 digits, and nothing else.
household.child.create.pin.label: PIN
household.child.create.private.body: An owner can read what a child keeps in their private space. It is the one difference from an adult’s, which nobody else can read. They are told so, in plain words, the first time they sign in.
household.child.create.private.title: Their private space
household.child.create.refused.full: A household has at most {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}, child profiles counted, and this one has that many. No profile was made.
household.child.create.starts.note: Every level can be changed on their own page once the profile is made.
household.child.create.starts.title: What they start with
household.child.create.title: Add a child profile
household.child.create.year.help: Optional. It is used only for age-appropriate defaults and a birthday reminder, and only the owners and the child see it.
household.child.create.year.invalid: A year of birth is four digits, from 1900 to this year. Leave it empty if you’d rather not give one.
household.child.create.year.label: Year of birth
household.child.graduate.email.help: The link is sent here, and this becomes the address they sign in with.
household.child.graduate.email.label: Their email address
household.child.graduate.email.required: Enter the address the link is sent to.
household.child.graduate.email.taken: That address can’t be used here. Another one can.
household.child.graduate.member: A link goes to the address. Once {name} has opened it and chosen a password, they are a member, with the levels they hold now and everything they made, and Home unlocks.
household.child.graduate.private: From then on the owners can no longer read {name}’s private notes: that is for child profiles only.
household.child.graduate.sent.again: Sending another link, to the same address or a corrected one, retires this one.
household.child.graduate.sent.body: A link is on its way to {email}. It works for 14 days.
household.child.graduate.sent.until: Until it is used, {name} is still a child profile and signs in with the PIN.
household.child.graduate.unverified: The link carries the household’s name to somebody’s mailbox on your word, so your own address is confirmed first.
household.child.graduate.what: Nothing is lost or copied: {name} stays the same person here, with an email address and a password in place of the PIN.
household.child.home.label: Home
household.child.home.locked: Locked: {name} sees the Home an owner set, and can’t rearrange it.
household.child.locked.body: Ten wrong PINs in a row locked it, which is how a guesser is kept out. Nothing is lost and nobody is in trouble. It stays locked until an owner unlocks it or sets a new PIN.
household.child.locked.title: This profile is locked
household.child.picture.help: A JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image, up to 20 MB. Its centred square is kept, and nothing of where or when it was taken.
household.child.picture.label: Picture
household.child.picture.no_uploads: The household takes no uploads just now, so the picture was not changed.
household.child.picture.too_large: That picture is over 20 MB. Choose a smaller one. The picture was not changed.
household.child.picture.unreadable: That file isn’t a picture Household can use. Choose a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image. The picture was not changed.
household.child.pin.label: New PIN
household.child.pin.malformed: A PIN is 4 to 6 digits, and nothing else.
household.child.pin.note: The old PIN stops working on every device at once, and {name} is signed out everywhere. A locked profile is unlocked by it. Tell {name} the new PIN in person: Household sends it nowhere.
household.child.pin.title: A new PIN for {name}
household.child.sign_in: {name} signs in with the household’s code, their profile and a PIN. A child profile has no email address.
household.child.title: {name}’s profile
household.child.unlock.done: {name} can sign in again with the same PIN.
household.create.child: A child profile is part of the household an owner made it in, and makes none of its own.
household.create.country.help: It decides which tariff presets, document types and statutory dates are offered.
household.create.country.label: Country
household.create.country.refused: Household has no profile of that country. Choose another.
household.create.currency.help: It follows the country until you choose one yourself.
household.create.currency.label: Money is counted in
household.create.currency.refused: That currency wasn’t accepted. Choose another.
household.create.language.help: What the household’s shared words and its emails are in. Each member’s own app language is theirs.
household.create.language.label: Language
household.create.language.refused: That language wasn’t accepted. Choose another.
household.create.language.shown: The language you are reading now.
household.create.lead: Only the name is asked. The rest is read from this device, and any of it can be changed.
household.create.limit: You own {ceiling, plural, one {# household} other {# households}} already, and one account owns no more than that. Nothing was created.
household.create.name.help: What the household is called on every screen and in every invitation.
household.create.name.label: Name
household.create.name.refused: That name wasn’t accepted. Use up to 80 letters, numbers and ordinary punctuation.
household.create.new.title: A new household
household.create.timezone.help: The household’s days begin and end in it.
household.create.timezone.label: Timezone
household.create.timezone.refused: That timezone wasn’t accepted. Choose another one near you.
household.create.title: Set up your household
household.create.trial.body: The trial starts when the household is created and runs for thirty days. There is no card to enter and nothing to cancel: if you do nothing at its end, the household keeps reading and exporting everything in it.
household.create.trial.title: Thirty days, no card
household.create.unread.body: A household is set up in a country, and the list of them did not arrive. Nothing was created. Check your connection and try again.
household.create.unread.title: The countries could not be read
household.create.waiting.none: An invitation sent to your address shows here once the address is verified. If somebody sent you a link, opening it is enough.
household.grant.admin.more: No more than “{level}” gives: changing anything in the settings is for an owner, whatever is set here.
household.grant.admin.none: In their app all the same, as in every member’s: the household’s profile, its members and its modules. Its invitations are not.
household.grant.admin.none_yours: In your app all the same, as in every member’s: the household’s profile, its members and its modules. Its invitations are not.
household.grant.admin.view: The household’s invitations, beside its profile, its members and its modules, which every member reads. Changing anything in the settings is for an owner.
household.grant.child_note: A child profile can’t set anything up, and can at most see Finance. The choices stop there.
household.grant.line_off: Off: {count, plural, one {# module} other {# modules}}
household.grant.module_off: Off for the whole household: this holds for when it is turned on.
household.grant.owner_note: An owner can set up every module. To narrow what {name} holds, make them a member first.
household.grant.says.contribute: Adding things, editing things, ticking things off.
household.grant.says.manage: The structural things too: seasons, tariffs, accounts, definitions.
household.grant.says.none: Not in their app at all: no screen, no widget, no search result, no reminder.
household.grant.says.none_yours: Not in your app at all: no screen, no widget, no search result, no reminder.
household.grant.says.view: Everything in it can be read, and nothing changed.
household.invitation.child.body: An owner of your household manages this profile, and it stays in the household it was made in. Nothing was changed.
household.invitation.child.title: A child profile joins no other household
household.invitation.declined.body: {inviter} is told. Nothing was added to your account.
household.invitation.declined.title: You declined the invitation to {household}
household.invitation.expired.body: An invitation sent by email lasts 14 days, and an invitation link 72 hours.
household.invitation.expired.next: Ask whoever invited you for another. Nothing about your account has changed.
household.invitation.expired.title: This invitation has expired
household.invitation.foot: Declining is recorded and {inviter} is told. It closes this invitation for good, and adds nothing to your account.
household.invitation.gone.body: It may have been cut short in copying. Or the invitation was sent again since, which gives it a new link and ends this one.
household.invitation.gone.next: Open the link from the newest email or message, or ask whoever invited you. Nothing about your account has changed.
household.invitation.gone.title: This link opens no invitation
household.invitation.invited.lede: Here is exactly what that gives you.
household.invitation.invited.title: {inviter} has invited you to {household}
household.invitation.later.body: {inviter}, or any other owner of the household, can raise or lower any of it. You are told when that happens, so you never find out by something going missing.
household.invitation.later.title: This can change later, and you will be told
household.invitation.mismatch.body: Either it was sent to a different email address than the one you are signed in with ({email}), or it stopped working a moment ago: it was withdrawn, answered, or sent again with a new link. We can’t tell which from here.
household.invitation.mismatch.next: If it was sent to another address of yours, sign out, sign in with that account and open the link again. Otherwise ask {inviter}.
household.invitation.mismatch.title: This invitation can’t be answered from this account
household.invitation.none.body: This page shows the invitation that a link carries, and the link that opened it looks incomplete. It also lets go of the link when it is reloaded.
household.invitation.none.next: Open the link again from the email or message it came in. An invitation sent to your email address also waits on your account, once that address is confirmed.
household.invitation.none.title: There is no invitation to show here
household.invitation.refused.full: {household} already has {ceiling, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}, which is as many as a household can have. The invitation still stands: somebody there has to make room before you can join.
household.invitation.refused.read_only: {household} takes no changes right now, because its subscription has lapsed, so your answer was not recorded. Nothing is wrong with the invitation or with you. Ask {inviter}, and answer once it is running again.
household.invitation.refused.restricted: {household} takes no changes right now, because an owner has put it on hold, so your answer was not recorded. Nothing is wrong with the invitation or with you. Ask {inviter}, and answer once that is lifted.
household.invitation.role.member.body: What you can do is exactly what is listed here, and nothing more.
household.invitation.role.member.title: You would join as a member
household.invitation.role.owner.body: An owner can set up everything, invite and remove people, turn modules on and off, and delete the household.
household.invitation.role.owner.title: You would join as an owner
household.invitation.title: An invitation to a household
household.invitation.unread.body: It is as it was, and nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again.
household.invitation.unread.title: The invitation could not be read
household.invitation.unverified: Joining a household is trust extended to your account, so your email address is confirmed first. Declining needs no confirmation.
household.invitation.used.body: It was accepted, declined or withdrawn, and it can’t be answered again. Opening it changed nothing about anybody’s account.
household.invitation.used.title: This invitation has already been answered
household.invitation.visitor.body: To join or to decline, sign in first. Nothing happens until you answer.
household.invitation.visitor.return: Signing in brings you straight back to this page. If you create an account instead, confirm your email address and then open this link again: an invitation sent to that address will also be waiting on your account.
household.invitations.declined.body: Nothing was shared with them, and the invitation is closed. If it was the access that gave them pause, you can invite them again with different modules: they see the whole list before they answer. Withdrawing the invitation below puts this notice away.
household.invitations.declined.body_link: Nothing was shared with them, and the link is closed for everybody who had it. If it was the access that gave them pause, you can make another with different modules: whoever opens it sees the whole list before they answer. Withdrawing the link below puts this notice away.
household.invitations.declined.title: {who} declined the invitation
household.invitations.declined.title_lin: Somebody who had the link declined
household.invitations.empty.example: Grandma’s email address, and seventeen answers about what she gets that are already filled in.
household.invitations.error.body: Nothing was sent, and nothing was withdrawn.
household.invitations.error.title: The invitations did not load
household.invitations.lead: Everybody this household has invited, and what became of each invitation.
household.invitations.resend.done: Sent again to {email}. The link sent before no longer works; this one works for 14 days.
household.invitations.row.link: A link, passed on by hand
household.invitations.row.sent_former: Sent by {name}, who is no longer a member · {day}
household.invitations.withdraw.body: The link in it stops working at once. Nothing else changes: nobody is removed, and you can invite them again.
household.invitations.withdraw.body_link: It stops working at once, for everybody who has it. Nothing else changes: whoever has joined with it stays.
household.invitations.withdraw.done: The invitation to {email} is withdrawn. Its link no longer works.
household.invitations.withdraw.done_link: The link is withdrawn. It no longer works.
household.invitations.withdraw.title: Withdraw the invitation to {email}?
household.invite.email.invalid: That address is missing something. Or send a link instead.
household.invite.email.label: Their email address
household.invite.email.required: Enter the address the invitation goes to.
household.invite.email.taken: An invitation is already waiting for this address, or it belongs to somebody who is a member already. The invitations and the member list show which.
household.invite.grants.counts: Of the seventeen modules: {manage} to set up, {contribute} to add and edit in, {view} to see, {none} off.
household.invite.grants.line: The defaults draw one line: what the household does together is open, and what it owns and spends is closed until somebody opens it. They see this whole list before they answer.
household.invite.grants.owner: An owner can set up every module, so there is nothing to choose here.
household.invite.grants.refused: This role can’t be given that level here. Choose another.
household.invite.grants.title: What they get
household.invite.how.email_note: It is theirs alone: only the account with that address can join with it. It works for 14 days.
household.invite.how.label: How they get it
household.invite.how.link: By a link I send myself
household.invite.how.link_note: Anybody who has the link can join with it, for 72 hours. It is shown once, on this page, when it is made, and a reload loses it: have somewhere to paste it.
household.invite.lead: Seventeen decisions, already answered. Change the ones you want to.
household.invite.lost.email: The answer to that was lost on its way back, so the invitation may have gone out all the same. Look in the invitations before you send it again.
household.invite.lost.link: The answer to that was lost on its way back, and a link is shown only once. If the invitations show a new link, withdraw it, then make another here.
household.invite.made.copy_failed: Copying didn’t work. Select the link and copy it yourself.
household.invite.made.label: The link
household.invite.made.once: Shown only this once. Copy it before you leave this page: a reload loses it.
household.invite.made.title: The link is made
household.invite.made.uses: {count, plural, one {One person can join with it.} other {# people can join with it.}}
household.invite.message.help: It is put in the email, as your own words. At most 500 characters.
household.invite.message.label: A message (optional)
household.invite.message.refused: The message can’t be sent as it is written. Keep it to 500 characters of plain text.
household.invite.offline.body: It carries your name to somebody else’s phone, so it needs a connection at the moment you send it. What you set here stays while this page is open.
household.invite.offline.title: An invitation can’t be sent offline
household.invite.owner_only: Inviting somebody is for an owner.
household.invite.owners: Inviting somebody is for an owner: {owners}.
household.invite.read_only.body: Inviting is a write, and writes are off until the subscription resumes. Everybody already in the household keeps reading.
household.invite.read_only.title: Read-only: no new members for now
household.invite.restricted.body: Inviting is a write, and writes are off until an owner lifts the restriction. Everybody already in the household keeps reading.
household.invite.restricted.title: Restricted: no new members for now
household.invite.role.child: A child profile is not invited: an owner makes one, with no invitation and no email address.
household.invite.role.child_link: Go to Members, where a child profile is made
household.invite.role.label: Role
household.invite.role.member_note: A member can do exactly what is set below, and nothing more.
household.invite.role.owner_note: Owners can set up everything, invite and remove people, turn modules on and off, and delete the household.
household.invite.sent: Sent to {email}. It works for 14 days.
household.invite.title: Invite somebody
household.invite.unverified: An invitation carries your name to somebody else’s phone, so your own address is confirmed before one goes.
household.invite.uses.help: From 1 to 12: a household has at most twelve members.
household.invite.uses.label: How many people may use it
household.leave.alone.body: Leaving would leave {household} with nobody in it. Deleting the household is what ends it.
household.leave.alone.title: You are the only member
household.leave.behind.body: What you added stays with the household, with your name on it: it is the household’s record. Your private notes and documents are deleted after thirty days, and you can export them until then.
household.leave.behind.title: What you leave behind
household.leave.child: A child profile doesn’t leave its household. An owner removes it, from the household’s members.
household.leave.confirm.title: Leave {household}?
household.leave.failed: Something went wrong at our end. You are still a member of {household}, and nothing has changed. Try again.
household.leave.intro.one: One thing has to be settled first.
household.leave.intro.two: Two things have to be settled first, and here they both are.
household.leave.last_owner.body: If you go, nobody is left who can invite, remove or change what anyone sees. Make somebody else an owner first.
household.leave.last_owner.deleting: An owner whose account is being deleted does not count as one.
household.leave.last_owner.title: You are the only owner
household.leave.payer.body: Billing has to be handed to another owner before you go. A household whose payer has left lapses for a reason nobody in it can fix.
household.leave.payer.title: You pay for the subscription
household.leave.refused.title: You can’t leave yet
household.leave.title: Leave {household}
household.leave.unreachable: We couldn’t reach Household, so you are still a member of {household} and nothing has changed. Check your connection and try again.
household.leave.unread.body: Whether anything stands in the way of leaving could not be worked out, so nothing is offered. You are still a member. Check your connection and try again.
household.leave.unread.title: This page could not be read
household.member.error.body: Nothing was changed, and nothing was lost.
household.member.error.title: This member’s page did not load
household.member.holds.change.admin_off: {name} no longer reads the household’s invitations. Its profile, its members and its modules stay theirs to read.
household.member.holds.change.lowered: {count, plural, one {# module is lowered.} other {# modules are lowered.}}
household.member.holds.change.off: {count, plural, one {{modules} leaves {name}’s app entirely, and their devices drop their copy of it.} other {{modules} leave {name}’s app entirely, and their devices drop their copy of them.}} Nothing they added is deleted.
household.member.holds.change.raised: {count, plural, one {# module is raised.} other {# modules are raised.}}
household.member.holds.off: Off for the whole household just now: {modules}. A level on a module that is off holds for when it is turned on.
household.member.holds.owner: An owner can set up every module.
household.member.holds.owner_you: You are an owner, and an owner can set up every module. That is not narrowed while you are one.
household.member.holds.put_back_said: The levels are back to what is saved.
household.member.holds.refused_level: That level can’t be given here. Choose another.
household.member.holds.saved: {name}’s access is saved. They are told.
household.member.holds.title: What {name} holds
household.member.own.note: You can’t change your own role or remove yourself here. Leaving {household} has its own screen.
household.member.own.title: Your membership
household.member.remove.confirm.body: What {name} added stays: it is the household’s record, with their name on it. Their private notes and documents are deleted after thirty days, and they can export them until then. {name} is told.
household.member.remove.confirm.child: The profile, its PIN and its sign-ins end with it: a child profile has no account outside the household. What {name} added stays, as the household’s record.
household.member.remove.confirm.title: Remove {name} from {household}?
household.member.remove.payer: {name} pays for the household, so billing moves to another owner before they can be removed.
household.member.remove.title: Remove from the household
household.member.role.member.body: {name} can no longer invite or remove people, change what anybody holds, or turn modules on and off. They keep the levels they hold now, which stay “{level}” until you lower them. The invitations they sent that are still waiting are withdrawn, and so are the links they sent to give a child profile its own sign-in.
household.member.role.member.done: {name} is a member. They are told.
household.member.role.member.title: Make {name} a member?
household.member.role.owner.body: Owners invite and remove people, change what each person holds, turn modules on and off, and can delete the household. An owner can set up every module. There can be several owners, and this does not move billing.
household.member.role.owner.done: {name} is an owner. They are told.
household.member.role.owner.title: Make {name} an owner?
household.member.role.payer: {name} pays for the household, so they stay an owner until billing has moved to another owner.
household.member.role.refused.last_owner: {name} is the household’s only owner, and a household keeps at least one. Nothing was changed.
household.member.role.refused.payer: {name} pays for the household, so they stay an owner until billing has moved to another owner. Nothing was changed.
household.member.role.title: Role
